data.description: Brand New 5BR Villa | Private Lift | Huge Plot
data.display_address: Al Barsha South 2, Al Barsha South, Al Barsha, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience luxury family living in this brand-new standalone villa located in the peaceful and highly sought-after Al Barsha South 2 community. Built with spacious layouts, premium finishing, and designed for comfortable family living, this exceptional home offers privacy, elegance, and convenience in a quiet residential neighborhood.

Situated on a generous **9843 plot**, this villa features expansive indoor and outdoor spaces, ideal for large families seeking premium living in Dubai.

Property Features:

5 Spacious Bedrooms – all with en-suite bathrooms
9 bathrooms
Private Lift (Elevator)
2 Large Family Halls with bathrooms
Guest Hall + Dedicated Dining Area
Big Air-Conditioned Balcony
2 Kitchens*with ample space and functionality
Laundry Room
Large Maid’s Room
4 Storage Rooms
Private Garden Area
Separate Service Block
Gardener’s Toilet
6 Covered Parking Spaces

Nestled in a quiet and family-friendly neighborhood, the villa offers easy access to schools, healthcare facilities, retail destinations, and major roads, making daily commuting seamless while maintaining a peaceful residential atmosphere.

This property is an ideal choice for families looking for a spacious, luxurious, and brand-new home in one of Dubai’s prime villa communities.

Contact us today to arrange a private viewing!
